planets.name: TOI-1422 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1422 with a 34.6-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-1422 c was found in 2025 by Roque de los Muchachos Observatory as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-1422. Its orbit and size follow Naponiello et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
